result.title: Hybrid state-space and attention neural operators for nonlinear structural dynamics under environmental loading
result.summary: The computational burden of repeated nonlinear time-history analyses limits their application for structural assessment and design. We therefore propose DeepOJamba, a hybrid neural operator that combines selective state-space recurrence with full attention to predict the structural response history due to dynamic loading. Physical-parameter conditioning and predicted-state transfer between sequences enable a single trained operator to represent varying system conditions and generate response histories beyond its training sequence length. DeepOJamba is evaluated on a 15~MW monopile offshore wind turbine under wind and wave loading. The proposed operator is compared to pure attention, pure state-space, Fourier, and DeepONet operators and is found to give the lowest window error on every channel and the lowest closed-loop fatigue and ultimate-load errors of $9.4\%$ and $6.0\%$, against $14.6\%$ and $8.7\%$ for the next-best pure attention operator examined. Moreover, on sea states outside the training wave band, the error slightly increases by approximately $0.4$ percentage points. Pure state-space operators can approach similar low errors only with a much wider convolution kernel tuned to the tower eigenperiod, which increases the training cost by $40\%$. In all, the results obtained support hybrid neural operators for robust long-duration structural response and demand prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DeepOJamba，将选择性状态空间递归与全注意力结合为混合神经算子，用物理参数条件化和序列间预测状态传递来预测海上风机在风浪载荷下的非线性响应历史，并能生成超出训练序列长度的轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测状态传递」实现长度外推、混合 SSM-注意力承担状态更新，可能为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的传递与长度泛化提供架构线索，但原文不涉及视觉证据或推理监督，需核查可迁移性。
